[Erowid Note: 
The term "acid" has been used as a common name for d-LSD since the 1960s. Although confusion associated with newer psychoactive substances has lead some people to use the term "acid" to refer to anything LSD-like or anything psychedelic on blotter or sold in drops, we believe this represents an error and not a useful evolution in language.]
Trip Report July 22, 2024
1 PM: Ingested 300ug ETH-LAD
1:30 PM: Ingested 150ug 1V-LSD

1:36 PM
Feeling extremely nauseous when I turn my head, I might even need the bucket. I feel really hot and shaky. It feels like my bowels are moving and I definitely have flatulence. I can tell I am in a happier mood after 40 minutes. Mild stimulation throughout body. Going to put on music to help calm the nausea.
1:47 PM
Wow the music helps calm the nausea so much!! Music on acid is the shit. It sounds amazing and I know I havent even hit the peak.
1:48 PM
I feel like crying right now. When I take acid I feel like crying and I dont know if this is normal but I usually do it a lot on acid. Im a very emotional person on acid.
1:54 PM
Thankfully the Intense nausea went away quickly. But I'm still dizzy and may throw up. I think the visuals are starting to take over my vision. I feel a stimulating but calm pulsing and buzzing energy throughout my entire body.
2:00 PM
I am getting whats known as frisson which is French for chills - from this beautiful music and Im listening to Slide by Calvin Harris. I am crying right now its so emotional. Ha this trip report probably sounds like a joke. But Its beautiful. Now I'm listening to Borderline by Tame Impala.
2:06 PM
I always feel very jittery on any analogue of acid just like I am right now. Feeling very euphoric, blissful, giggly. I am really in a state of paradise right now.
2:23 PM
While making sure to stay hydrated, I'm outside and everything is melting together. Nature is gorgeous. Everything that is further away seems closer than it really is. Patterns are swirling on every surface that I look at. Heavy tracers when I move my hands, feet or even a water bottle.
2:45 PM
This is the point where I ask myself did I take too much? Im asking myself this because this is so intense. Vision is blurry and strong geometric visuals are spawning. I get one life and Im going to live it to the fullest. Listening to Deep Jungle Walk by Astrix 6 minutes in.
3:30 PM
Lots of ringing in my ears and I have a good tingling sensation in my hands. Getting harder to move my body but not in a bad way. This is definitely kicking in. Im going to enjoy the rest of my trip. I hope you all have fun out there. Stay safe and enjoy yourselves at the same time. You deserve it.
4:45 PM
Im still alive and happy listening to Feeling Good by Avicii.
5:00 PM
I always learn at the end of every trip that its more than just recreational but it's very introspective. There is so much to learn.
